# PrepWithTee

> Cambridge O Level, IGCSE and A Level exam prep from Lahore: topical past papers with official mark schemes, papers by year, instantly marked MCQ practice, revision notes, study tools and one-on-one tutoring.

Every past-paper question is a crop of the original Cambridge PDF, classified by syllabus chapter. Pages behind sign-in (dashboards, paper viewers, the AI tutor) are for enrolled students.

## Past papers

- [Topical past papers](https://prepwithtee.com/papers): pick a board and subject, then build a booklet by chapter and subtopic
- [O Level](https://prepwithtee.com/papers/o-level): Maths 4024, Physics 5054, Chemistry 5070, Computer Science 2210
- [IGCSE](https://prepwithtee.com/papers/igcse): Maths 0580, Physics 0625, Chemistry 0620, Computer Science 0478
- [AS & A Level](https://prepwithtee.com/papers/a-level): Maths 9709, Physics 9702, Computer Science 9618
- [Papers by year](https://prepwithtee.com/yearly): every sitting with its mark scheme
- [MCQ practice](https://prepwithtee.com/mcq): timed multiple-choice papers, marked instantly

## Study resources

- [Revision notes](https://prepwithtee.com/notes): chapter-by-chapter notes on the current syllabus
- [Formula sheets](https://prepwithtee.com/formulas.html)
- [Command words](https://prepwithtee.com/command-words.html)
- [Study tools](https://prepwithtee.com/tools.html): calculator, graph plotter, grade calculator, pseudocode runner, periodic table
- [Photo Solver](https://prepwithtee.com/solver): photograph a question for a worked solution, or check your own working
- [Blog](https://prepwithtee.com/blog)
